cues.setting: A language trainer is preparing a recorded German train-transfer lesson in OpenScene Studio
cues.actor: OpenScene Studio, the language trainer, and a learner who cannot use stairs
cues.object: The recorded German transfer lesson and the missing lift question
cues.action: OpenScene shows the train-transfer announcement and the learner's unmet practice need
cues.visibleEvidence: The recorded station employee, railway transfer announcement, learner access need, and missing German lift question appear in order
cues.consequence: The viewer understands the product, the lesson, the learner, and the exact missing exchange before ChatGPT appears
cues.text: OpenScene Studio is a video-lesson editor for language trainers. A recorded German lesson lacks the lift question a learner who cannot use stairs needs.

cues.setting: The OpenScene project is open beside ChatGPT before the trainer sends the request
cues.object: An approved lift response clip and the missing learner exchange
cues.action: The trainer asks ChatGPT to add the approved lift exchange to the open project and preview it
cues.visibleEvidence: The complete request names the access need, approved content, OpenScene project, and learner preview
cues.consequence: ChatGPT receives one specific authoring request instead of an open-ended request for travel advice
cues.text: The trainer asks ChatGPT to add the approved lift response clip to OpenScene.

cues.setting: A privacy-cropped recording of the real ChatGPT and OpenScene browser session
cues.actor: ChatGPT and the same live OpenScene page
cues.object: The authentic ChatGPT result, the exact final WebMCP call, and the resulting OpenScene page version
cues.action: The film establishes the real split-screen, then enlarges the final preview call and the paused OpenScene result
cues.visibleEvidence: The real ChatGPT result and same OpenScene page appear together before an exact call overlay and page close-up show revision two waiting for the learner
cues.consequence: The judge sees an authentic agent session change the same open page
cues.text: The recorded split-screen shows the real ChatGPT result beside the same OpenScene project. The next frame shows the exact final WebMCP call: preview the lift branch at page version one. OpenScene returns version two and waits for the learner.

cues.setting: The OpenScene lesson after ChatGPT has selected the approved lift exchange
cues.object: The missing German sentence, the open lesson timeline, and the approved response clip
cues.action: ChatGPT inserts the missing exchange through actions exposed by OpenScene
cues.visibleEvidence: The frame contrasts a German sentence returned in a separate chat with the question, learner pause, approved filmed answer, and undoable page version added to the open OpenScene lesson
cues.consequence: The trainer can preview a working lesson change instead of rebuilding the exchange by hand
cues.text: ChatGPT can explain the sentence in chat. Through WebMCP, it places that sentence, the approved answer, and the pause inside the lesson that is already open.

cues.setting: The trainer-approved lift answer clip inside the OpenScene editor
cues.object: One reusable answer clip for the lift situation
cues.action: The trainer records one approved answer clip for the situation and OpenScene reuses it when that situation recurs
cues.visibleEvidence: The German line, response clip, route board, and pause time remain one page-owned unit
cues.consequence: The prototype reuses approved media instead of generating bespoke footage for every learner
cues.text: The trainer records each approved answer once. OpenScene reuses that clip whenever the same situation appears in another lesson. A new situation still needs a new recording.

cues.setting: The updated lesson video reaches the new learner turn in preview
cues.object: The recorded response clip and the learner's three German choices
cues.action: OpenScene stops the video before the approved response and waits for the learner
cues.visibleEvidence: The paused video, three German choices with meanings, and locked-response label are visible together
cues.consequence: The response cannot start before the learner takes the missing turn
cues.text: The updated lesson stops before the answer. The learner sees three German questions and must choose the one that asks for the lift.

cues.setting: The learner's turn inside the paused OpenScene lesson
cues.object: The German sentence that asks for the lift to railway platform two
cues.action: The learner identifies and selects the matching German line
cues.visibleEvidence: The cursor lands inside the lift choice, the selected state appears, and the English meaning remains visible
cues.consequence: OpenScene can start the approved response clip
cues.text: The learner selects the lift question. OpenScene shows its English meaning and starts the matching approved answer.

cues.setting: The approved response after the learner selects the German lift question
cues.object: The approved lift answer, scene partner, and route board
cues.action: The narrator names the page change while the matching response clip is visible
cues.visibleEvidence: The scene partner turns, points left, and presents the German answer, English meaning, and lift route on screen
cues.consequence: The learner sees the response that follows the selected question
cues.text: Her choice releases the scene, the station agent turns, presents the lift route, and gives the matching answer on screen.
cues.antecedent: the learner introduced in the opening scene

cues.object: The German lift question and its on-screen answer
cues.action: The learner completes the missing exchange inside the original lesson
cues.visibleEvidence: The German question and recorded answer remain visible beside the scene partner
cues.consequence: The learner leaves with one German phrase rehearsed before travelling
cues.text: She leaves with one German phrase rehearsed before travel.
cues.antecedent: the learner introduced in the opening scene

cues.setting: The trainer reviews the new lift exchange in the OpenScene editor
cues.action: The trainer keeps the practice or undoes the change
cues.visibleEvidence: The page version, Keep Practice control, and Undo Change control remain visible
cues.consequence: ChatGPT cannot make the final publishing decision
cues.text: The trainer reviews one visible project change, then keeps it or undoes it. ChatGPT cannot make that final decision.

cues.setting: The literal WebMCP registration used by the OpenScene page
cues.object: Six page-defined tools with typed inputs and revision checks
cues.action: OpenScene registers the tools through document.modelContext.registerTool
cues.visibleEvidence: The literal registration line, one narrow schema, and the six-tool count are readable
cues.consequence: ChatGPT can edit the project only through actions defined by the page, while the trainer retains the keep-or-undo decision
cues.text: WebMCP gives ChatGPT a narrow way into the same page.

cues.action: OpenScene demonstrates bounded video-lesson authoring without reading live station systems
cues.visibleEvidence: The end frame names the live app, public source, fictional media, and no-live-guidance boundary
cues.consequence: The film ends with the exact product scope rather than implying a live travel assistant
